criteria.criterion: cmd/vloop/b8_e2e_test.go holds TestWorkedExampleB8, which plays every line of the brief's worked example with the stub claude in a temp repo and asserts its exit codes, messages and effects; it uses no absolute path in anything it commits.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b8_e2e_test.go has 14 subtests, one per line of the brief's worked example. Each asserts the exit code, the quoted message and the effect (no sleep left, evil branch absent, revert, redaction, pid named). Paths come from the temp repo helpers, and none are written into committed files.

criteria.criterion: go test ./... passes, as do gofmt, go vet, go mod tidy -diff and the linux and windows builds.
criteria.evidence: gates/T18.log ends with GATE OK, and the gate runs all of these checks.

criteria.evidence: The gate builds the base commit, runs cmp on the metrics output of each consumed brief, requires at least 7 briefs, and ended GATE OK.
